glad 0.1.36, OpenGL 3.3 loader (https://glad.dav1d.de/), copied from the CGP library
(cgp/third_party/glad/opengl33) without its CGP version guard.
The generated glad.hpp and glad.cpp hold no license statement: see https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad
for the terms of the generated code. khrplatform.hpp is under the Khronos license in its header.
